dedupe_keys.name: infrastructure de recharge de vehicules electriques irve

description: Infrastructure de Recharge de Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) is a dataset listed in chateauroux-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CHARGELEC / SDEI 36. Localisation des points de recharge de véhicules électriques. Source: Chargelec. Coverage: Châteauroux Métropole (Indre). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Environnement. Its keywords are véhicule électrique, borne, recharge. The portal shows 28 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-chateauroux-metropole-fr-portal.
